label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Evergreen Content: Always Fresh for Your Audience
body: Evergreen content is material that stays relevant and useful to your audience over a long period, without needing frequent updates.
caption:
Think of a timeless "how-to" guide or a fundamental explanation of a core concept in your niche. Once you create it, it can keep attracting readers and providing value for months or even years. This means less constant content creation pressure for you and more consistent helpfulness for your audience. Consider what fundamental topics your audience often searches for!
